blocks.name: the calendar
blocks.shows: what is due when, and for whom. Each person's Sol reminds them ten minutes before, or at nine on the day

blocks.name: decisions
blocks.shows: what this project decided, only ever added to. Every agent reads it with the goal before it works

blocks.name: polls
blocks.shows: one question, two to five answers, one vote a person, changed until it closes

blocks.name: project settings
blocks.shows: the rhythm and its reviewers, what agents share, who leads what, which blocks are on. A change applies once the people it names agree

blocks.name: this week's nights
blocks.shows: what went into the project on the dev nights this week, what was sent back, and which releases went on to beta or were held
does: read the week, day by day

reads.what: the review session's words: a change taken in or sent back, re-checked, broke; a release sent on to beta or held
reads.from: the comments on the project's issues and pull requests, as Cowork's feed reads them

reads.what: the pull requests that landed on main, and who made them

blocks.name: analytics
blocks.shows: how the beta testers use Sol over 30 days: use by day, what is used and in which mode, the testers, which release they run, and which parts of Cowork their agents read
does: read the counts, day by day
see which release each version is

reads.what: each beta tester's events: kept on the cloud by name, not anonymous; this page gets counts only (by day, name, mode, version), never a word of what they did
reads.from: Sol's cloud, its track summary, with your own sign-in there; only the names on the cloud's readers list may read it

reads.what: Cowork's parts their agents read (cowork.used), counted by part
the releases, to place each version on
reads.from: the timeline, Sol's own checkout and GitHub

blocks.name: features
blocks.shows: the feature map, for Sol developers only: each lasting part of Sol as a Sol user sees it and as it is built, its lead and support, and whether its evals are approved
does: see the features by where they live in the app
see them by label, lead and support

reads.what: the feature map and each feature's evals
reads.from: the project's own files, in the checkout this Sol runs from

reads.what: who leads each label, and who the Sol developers are
reads.from: the project's settings: the ownership table and the reviewers

reads.what: the last nightly re-sort's line and its undo
reads.from: the project's record, written by the nightly re-sort

blocks.name: live
blocks.shows: what is running and how it is doing: the newest dev release, what the morning run said about it, and the errors on Sol testers' and Sol developers' Macs by feature, type of error and Sol version
does: see the release Sol developers run
see which features have errors, and on which release

reads.what: the error counts: which engine file, what type of error, which Sol version, never what failed or a word of it
reads.from: Sol's cloud, its track summary, with your own sign-in there; only the names on the cloud's readers list may read it

reads.what: the morning run's line on the newest dev release: the gate and the first-timer, as counts
reads.from: the project's open nightly issue on GitHub, its newest Morning run comment

reads.what: the newest dev release, and which feature each file belongs to
reads.from: the timeline, and the feature map in Sol's own checkout

blocks.name: pages
blocks.shows: the project's own pages, written by its people and their agents, each a file in the project's record. Type / for headings, lists, a checklist, a divider, a mention or a block

blocks.name: templates
blocks.shows: pages the team starts from: a meeting's notes, a plan, a checklist. Make a page from one, or save a page as one; {{date}} and {{me}} fill themselves in
does: make a page from a template
save a page as a template

blocks.name: tables
blocks.shows: the project's tables, each seen as a list, a board, a calendar or a timeline. The board is the first; a table can also read the feed or the sessions, and keeps itself current
does: put a table on a page with /table

blocks.name: who's on
blocks.shows: each person on the team, their mark, and the session they are in

blocks.name: eyes wanted
blocks.shows: the pull requests waiting for a review: open, not a draft, no approval yet

blocks.name: who leads what
blocks.shows: the labels and their leads, as CODEOWNERS says them on main

blocks.name: copy the link
blocks.shows: an item in a card's menu on the action board
